how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.ECHS Dehradun.gov.in to download the application form format.
Fill out the application form carefully with the required details.
Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials supporting educational qualifications and work experience.
Ensure the application reaches the designated authority by 23 October 2026 at 1600 hrs.
Submit the application form along with enclosures to OIC, ECHS Dehradun Cell, Station Headquarters Clement Town by post or in person.
important_instructions: The contract duration is for one year for Ex-Servicemen and 11 months for civil candidates. Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM). Applications received after 23 October 2026 at 1600 hrs will not be accepted. Candidates must bring all original certificates and mark sheets at the time of the interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Selected individuals must complete 10 days of On Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract. The OJT period will remain unpaid and is a mandatory requirement before assuming charge. For additional details, contact ECHS Dehradun Polyclinic Cell Station Headquarters Clement Town at Telephone No 0135-2641234 or email [email protected].

The OJT period will remain unpaid and is a mandatory requirement before assuming charge. faq.question: Q1. What is ECHS Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an employment notice issued by ECHS Polyclinic, Clement Town, Dehradun to engage Medical Staff and Non-Para Med Staff on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available for Medical Specialist, Female Attendant, Safai Wala, and Peon posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 23 October 2026 by 1600 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Medical Specialist?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Medical Specialist is 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fixed remuneration for Medical Specialist?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration for Medical Specialist is 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted to OIC, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters Clement Town.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any training period after selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected individuals must complete 10 days of unpaid On Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate before signing the contract.
